This is just a reminder that there are exactly 7 readings left for writing assignments.
There are five weeks left before the end of the semester, but since there are two papers each for weeks 13 and 14, you can still submit two assignments per week if needed to meet the requirement.

Because we require a total of 7 writing assignments, just want to remind that if you haven't started yet,
it's not too late! The weekly schedule on the syllabus can be used to plan out which readings you'd like to write about.
